claims.text: The hotel is an oceanfront retreat on Collins Avenue in Mid-Beach.

findings.quote: Located along Collins Avenue in Mid-Beach, this oceanfront retreat

claims.text: Its design merges Art Deco character with modern design, infused with local texture and detail.

findings.quote: this oceanfront retreat merges Art Deco character with modern design, infused with local texture and detail.

claims.text: The complex was originally built in the 1940s as the 18-floor Lord Tarleton Hotel, Miami Beach's first skyscraper.

findings.quote: The three-building complex has a rich history, originally built in the 1940s as the 18-floor Lord Tarleton Hotel, Miami Beach's first skyscraper.

claims.text: The hotel occupies a full city block, with plenty of sitting areas and lounges for quiet moments.

findings.quote: Occupying a full city block, the hotel is sprawling but feels intimate, with plenty of sitting areas and lounges for quiet moments.

claims.text: The lobby is in hues of aqua, mint, turquoise and sage, with floor-to-ceiling windows framing views of the Atlantic.

findings.quote: The elevated lobby is awash in hues of aqua, mint, turquoise, and sage—echoing the views of the Atlantic framed by floor-to-ceiling windows and curvilinear couches.

claims.text: Many rooms and suites have private balconies with oceanfront or city skyline views.

findings.quote: many offer private balconies with sweeping oceanfront views or glittering city skylines

claims.text: Rooms have Byredo bath amenities and a Nespresso coffee maker.

findings.quote: each features luxurious linens, Byredo bath amenities, a Nespresso coffee maker, and a hotel-branded beach bag in each room

claims.text: The multi-level pool decks have two pools.

findings.quote: the expansive multi-level pool decks, which feature two pools

claims.text: Daily wellness programs feature signature classes, many complimentary for guests, from yoga flow to high-intensity interval training.

findings.quote: Experience daily wellness programs featuring signature classes, many complimentary for Andaz Miami Beach Resort & Spa guests. From yoga flow to high-intensity interval training

claims.text: The hotel is home to three José Andrés restaurants.

findings.quote: Home to three celebrated José Andrés restaurants

claims.text: Guests can use the hotel's on-site electric bikes to ride the paved beach path along the ocean.

findings.quote: The paved beach path that flanks the ocean is great for morning walks or for bike rides using the hotel’s on-site electric bikes.

claims.text: The terrace swimming pool has a hydraulic floor that rises to create a solid surface for special events, a first for Miami.

findings.quote: And—a first for Miami—the property’s terrace swimming pool features a hydraulic floor system that seamlessly elevates the pool floor to create a solid surface fitting for special events.

claims.text: The Ondara spa sits on the fourth-floor terrace, offering advanced skincare and touchless therapies with Obagi products, and its relaxation lounge has loungers with ocean views.

findings.quote: Ondara spa, perched on the fourth-floor terrace, features all of the cutting-edge beauty and wellness treatments that Miami is known for, including advanced skincare and touchless therapies using Obagi Skincare products
The relaxation lounge where you await your treatment features ergonomic loungers with views of the ocean

claims.text: The Two-Bedroom Ocean Terrace Suite with Soaking Tub has two king bedrooms, an oversized soaking tub and a wraparound terrace with panoramic ocean views.

findings.quote: ## Two-Bedroom Ocean Terrace Suite with Soaking Tub
This two-bedroom suite features two king bedrooms and two separate bathrooms, including a signature bath with an oversized soaking tub. A wraparound terrace opens to panoramic ocean views

claims.text: There is no check-in desk: each guest is seated and personally welcomed with a cocktail.

findings.quote: In signature Andaz fashion, there is no check-in desk; instead, each guest is seated and personally welcomed with a cocktail

claims.text: A historic 1929 single-family house on site has been preserved and restored as the clubhouse for a private members club on the property.

findings.quote: A 1929 historic, single-family house is located on-site and has been preserved and restored to function as the clubhouse for a private members club on property.

claims.text: The hotel is in Mid-Beach: South Beach is a 15-minute drive away, though Soho House and the Fontainebleau are within walking distance.

findings.quote: Located in mid-beach, the hotel feels off-the-beaten path
South Beach is a 15-minute drive away, but there’s also the neighboring Soho House and the Fontainebleau hotels within walking distance

claims.text: Self-parking is on-street at Miami Beach city parking rates; the hotel itself offers valet parking.

findings.quote: Available on-street parking at Miami Beach city parking rates.
Andaz Miami Beach Resort & Spa is pleased to offer overnight valet parking for registered hotel guests

claims.text: Pets are welcome, but not in restaurants, on the pool deck or beach, in the Andaz Lounge or in the fitness center.

findings.quote: Your pets are welcome at Andaz Miami Beach Resort & Spa.
are not allowed in restaurants, the pool deck, beach, Andaz Lounge or fitness center
